title: The Lighthouse Postcard
logline: Nora returns to her childhood coastal town to sell her aunt's bookstore, then a postcard from 1994 arrives and changes the plan.
setting: Marrow Bay, a fictional harbor town on the Maine coast: the bookstore at the end of the pier, the diner, the lighthouse, the town hall, and the ferry dock.
tone: Warm coastal slice-of-life with a gentle mystery and dry New England humor.
sensitivityNotes: Grief for Aunt June is present but never graphic.
The town's economic decline is shown with respect, not pity.
No caricature of rural Maine accents; regional speech is light and glossed.

canon.timeline: Late September to December, present day; the postcard is dated 1994.
rules: The lighthouse is decommissioned but maintained by the town.
The bookstore cat is named Page.

characters.name: Nora
characters.role: Protagonist, 26, returns to sell the bookstore
characters.bio: Nora left Marrow Bay at eighteen and built a careful life in Boston. She comes back to settle her aunt's estate and plans to leave before the first snow.
characters.speechStyle: Dry, practical, softer than she admits
characters.quote: I'm not staying. I just need to sell the place.

characters.name: Eli
characters.bio: Eli stayed in Marrow Bay and fishes the same waters his father did. He remembers Nora better than she remembers herself.
characters.quote: The town remembers you, even if you don't.

characters.name: Mrs. Hale
characters.bio: Mrs. Hale has catalogued every town meeting since 1978. She is the first to notice that the postcard is not ordinary mail.

characters.name: Page
characters.bio: Page has slept on the same stack of nautical charts for nine years. He sits on anything important.

characters.name: Aunt June
characters.role: Nora's late aunt, the bookstore's owner
characters.bio: June ran the bookstore for forty years. She wrote postcards she never sent and kept every receipt in a blue ledger.
characters.quote: Some letters arrive late on purpose.

quote.native: Meet me at the light when the fog lifts.

gloss.id: Temui aku di mercusuar saat kabut menyingkir.
gloss.en: Meet me at the light when the fog lifts.

anchors.title: The Maine diner

body.id: Diner pesisir Maine adalah ruang makan sederhana yang buka pagi-pagi, dengan counter panjang, kopi refill, dan pelanggan yang dikenal namanya. Di Marrow Bay, diner menjadi tempat pertama orang mendengar kabar.
body.en: A Maine coastal diner is a plain, early-opening room with a long counter, refill coffee, and customers known by name. In Marrow Bay, the diner is where news travels first.

sources: Maine Office of Tourism, 'Maine Diners and Lobster Shacks' (reference)
Interview notes with coastal Maine residents (fictionalized composite)

reflection.id: Mengapa diner penting bagi komunitas kecil?
reflection.en: Why does a diner matter to a small community?

anchors.title: The lobster roll

body.id: Lobster roll adalah roti panjang berisi daging lobster yang dimasak ringan, disajikan dingin dengan mayones atau hangat dengan mentega. Harganya mengikuti hasil tangkapan dan musim.
body.en: A lobster roll is a split-top bun filled with lightly cooked lobster, served cold with mayonnaise or warm with butter. Its price follows the catch and the season.

sources: Maine Lobster Marketing Collaborative, 'Lobster Roll Basics' (reference)

reflection.id: Bagaimana makanan mengikuti musim dan kerja orang?
reflection.en: How does food follow seasons and people's work?

body.id: Mercusuar di pesisir Maine dibangun untuk menandai tanjung dan pelabuhan. Saat kabut turun, suara kabut (foghorn) menggantikan cahaya sebagai penanda. Banyak mercusuar kini otomatis, tetapi tetap menjadi lambang kota.
body.en: Maine's coastal lighthouses mark headlands and harbors. When fog rolls in, a foghorn replaces the light as the signal. Many are now automated, but they remain town symbols.

reflection.id: Mengapa mercusuar tetap penting setelah otomatis?
reflection.en: Why do lighthouses still matter after automation?

body.id: Town meeting adalah pertemuan warga yang memutuskan anggaran, jalan, dan proyek bersama. Di banyak kota kecil New England, keputusan besar diambil dengan suara terbuka, bukan hanya oleh dewan.
body.en: A town meeting is a residents' assembly that decides budgets, roads, and shared projects. In many small New England towns, major decisions are made by open vote, not only by a council.

reflection.id: Apa untung dan rugi keputusan bersama?
reflection.en: What are the costs and benefits of deciding together?

body.id: County fair menampilkan hasil pertanian, kerajinan, dan makanan lokal, serta kompetisi kecil seperti pai terbaik atau labu terbesar. Fair adalah kalender sosial desa.
body.en: A county fair displays local agriculture, crafts, and food, with small competitions such as best pie or largest pumpkin. It is a village's social calendar.

reflection.id: Mengapa kompetisi kecil bisa merekatkan warga?
reflection.en: Why can small competitions bring people together?

body.id: Thanksgiving di kota pelabuhan sering menjadi momen keluarga pulang, dengan makan malam besar dan cerita tentang musim tangkapan. Bagi keluarga nelayan, musim menentukan siapa yang bisa hadir.
body.en: Thanksgiving in a harbor town is often when family returns, with a large dinner and stories about the fishing season. For fishing families, the season decides who can be there.

reflection.en: How does seasonal work shape family life?

anchors.title: The small-town library

body.id: Perpustakaan kecil di kota pesisir menyimpan surat kabar lama, peta, dan arsip keluarga. Pustakawan sering menjadi penghubung antara generasi.
body.en: A small coastal library keeps old newspapers, maps, and family archives. The librarian often becomes a bridge between generations.

sources: American Library Association, small and rural libraries (reference)

reflection.id: Apa yang disimpan perpustakaan yang tidak disimpan tempat lain?
reflection.en: What does a library keep that nowhere else does?

body.id: Humor New England sering datar, singkat, dan tidak menjelaskan leluconnya. Keheningan adalah bagian dari percakapan; keramahan ditunjukkan lewat tindakan, bukan kata-kata besar.
body.en: New England humor is often dry, brief, and does not explain itself. Silence is part of conversation; kindness is shown through action, not grand words.

reflection.id: Bagaimana humor menunjukkan kedekatan tanpa banyak kata?
reflection.en: How can humor show closeness without many words?

arcs.title: The Key
arcs.synopsis: Nora plans to sell the bookstore in a week. A brass key and a cat make that plan difficult.
arcs.cliffhanger: The key opens the lighthouse door, but someone has been inside.

arcs.title: The Cat and the Clock
arcs.synopsis: Page the cat keeps sitting on a clock that stopped in 1994. Nora follows the cat's routine through the town.
arcs.cliffhanger: The clock starts again at midnight.

arcs.title: The Postcard
arcs.synopsis: A postcard dated 1994 arrives with no stamp. Nora and Eli trace the handwriting through the harbor.
arcs.cliffhanger: The handwriting is Aunt June's, but the signature is E.

arcs.title: The Ferry Schedule
arcs.synopsis: The last ferry is cancelled, and a stranger asks Nora to keep a package until morning.
arcs.cliffhanger: The package contains the missing half of the postcard.

arcs.title: The Storm
arcs.synopsis: A nor'easter damages the lighthouse lens. The town must decide whether to repair it or let it go.
arcs.cliffhanger: The storm uncovers a box buried under the lighthouse steps.

arcs.title: The Missing Boat
arcs.synopsis: Eli's boat disappears before the season's last haul. Nora finds a tide chart marked with a route no one uses.
arcs.cliffhanger: The boat is anchored beyond the lighthouse, empty.

arcs.title: The Town Meeting
arcs.synopsis: A developer wants the pier for a hotel. Nora must choose between selling the bookstore and speaking for the town.
arcs.cliffhanger: The ledger shows the pier was sold once before, in 1994.

arcs.title: The Ledger
arcs.synopsis: The blue ledger records every loan Aunt June forgave. One name repeats for thirty years.

arcs.title: The Light
arcs.synopsis: Nora reads the letters Aunt June never sent and learns why the lighthouse was kept dark one winter.
arcs.cliffhanger: The last letter is addressed to Nora.

arcs.title: The Last Ferry
arcs.synopsis: Nora's last day in Marrow Bay arrives. The town, the bookstore, and Eli wait for her decision.
arcs.cliffhanger: At the dock, Nora buys a one-way ticket back.
